segments.zh: 各位英语学习者，大家好。

segments.en: And today we're going to be bringing you a very useful lesson about being sick.
segments.zh: 今天我们要为大家带来一节非常实用的课，主题是生病。

segments.en: We're going to learn how to tell your boss that you can't go to work because you're sick.
segments.zh: 我们将学习如何告诉你的老板你不能去上班，因为你生病了。

segments.en: This is really important because we all get sick and sometimes you just can't go to work.
segments.zh: 这真的很重要，因为我们都生病了，有时你就是不能去上班。

segments.en: Or maybe sometimes you just don't want to go to work. Exactly. Maybe you're lying.
segments.zh: 或者有时你只是不想去上班。 没错。 也许你在撒谎。

segments.en: But we're going to be teaching you how to do it anyway. So before we start with our dialogue, let's take a look at vocabulary preview. Vocabulary preview.
segments.zh: 但无论如何，我们将教您如何做到这一点。 因此，在我们开始对话之前，让我们看一下词汇预览。 词汇预览。

segments.en: In this vocabulary preview, we have two words for you.
segments.zh: 在这段词汇预览中，我们先讲两个词。

segments.en: The first one is quite ill.
Quite ill. Quite ill. So quite ill.
segments.zh: Quite ill。Quite ill。所以 quite ill 就是……

segments.en: Quite is a synonym of very.
segments.zh: Quite 是 very 的同义词。

segments.en: So they both mean the same thing. No difference.
segments.zh: 所以他们两个的意思是一样的。 没有区别。

segments.en: I just think ill is more common in British English.
segments.zh: 我只是觉得 ill 在英式英语里更常用。

segments.en: Exactly. All right. Let's take a look at our second word. Flu. The flu.
segments.zh: 没错。 好的。 让我们来看看我们的第二个词。 流感。 流感。

segments.en: So the flu is a virus.
And it's very similar to a cold.
Yes, but just a lot worse.
So it's stronger. Yep. Yep. It's also called influenza.
segments.zh: 所以它更厉害。 是的。 是的。 它也叫 influenza。

segments.en: So let's listen to our dialogue.
segments.zh: 所以让我们听听我们的对话。

segments.en: What's going to happen here today?
Well, we're going to listen as Julie calls her boss to tell him she's sick.
segments.zh: 好吧，我们要听朱莉打电话给她的老板，告诉他她病了。

segments.en: Hi, Daniel. Julie here. Oh, hi, Julie.
segments.zh: 嗨，丹尼尔，我是朱莉。哦，嗨，朱莉。

segments.en: Actually, I'm feeling quite ill today.
segments.zh: 其实，我今天身体很不舒服。

segments.en: Oh, I'm sorry to hear that.
segments.zh: 哦，听到这个消息我很遗憾。

segments.en: I think I'm coming down with the flu. I have a headache, a sore throat, a runny nose, and I'm feeling slightly feverish. I see. So you're calling in sick.
segments.zh: 我好像得了流感，头痛、喉咙痛、流鼻涕，还有点发烧。明白了，所以你是打电话请病假。

segments.en: I was hoping to take the day off to recover.
segments.zh: 我想请一天假休息恢复。

segments.en: Okay, then try and get some rest.
So Julie didn't really seem to be sick, huh?
segments.zh: 所以朱莉似乎并没有生病，对吧？

segments.en: I don't know. That cough was just a little too much.
segments.zh: 我不知道。那咳嗽得也太入戏了点。

segments.en: It seemed like she was acting.
So let's take a look at some of this vocabulary in language takeaway.
segments.zh: 所以让我们来看看语言要点里的一些词汇。

segments.en: We have five words for you here, and these are all great words to describe a sickness, right? All right.
segments.zh: 我们在这里有五个词要讲，这些都是描述疾病的好词，对吧？ 好的。

segments.en: So when you have a headache, you have a sore head, right?
segments.zh: 所以当你头疼的时候，就是头会痛，对吧？

segments.en: Right. Your head hurts. So it's pretty simple.
segments.zh: 对。 你的头疼。 所以很简单。

segments.en: It's the way you feel after being at the bar too late. Yeah. When you drink too much, you get a headache.
segments.zh: 这是你在酒吧太晚后的感觉。 是的。 当你喝得太多时，你会头疼。

segments.en: Let's take a look at our next word.
So basically we have two words here.
segments.zh: 所以基本上我们在这里有两个词。

segments.en: Let's look at the first one.
It hurts, right? Yeah. And your throat is?
segments.zh: 很痛，对吧？ 是的。 那喉咙是哪儿？

segments.en: Well, you know, it's the part right here at the back.
segments.zh: 嗯，你知道，就是后面这里的那一部分。

segments.en: Well, it's the part at the back of your mouth that goes down to your stomach.
segments.zh: 好吧，它是你嘴巴后面的部分，一直延伸到你的胃里。

segments.en: So you use your throat to swallow.
Now we can use the word sore with different body parts, right?
segments.zh: 现在我们可以在不同的身体部位使用 sore 这个词，对吧？
是的。 就像背痛一样。

segments.en: Or maybe you were playing tennis all weekend, so you have a sore arm.
segments.zh: 或者你整个周末都在打网球，所以你的手臂酸痛。
所以就是 sore 这个词。

segments.en: Let's take a look at our third word.
segments.zh: 让我们来看看我们的第三个词。

segments.en: Runny nose. This is a very strange word.
segments.zh: 流鼻涕。 这是一个非常奇怪的词。

segments.en: But it doesn't mean that your nose is running, right?
segments.zh: 但这并不是说你的鼻子在跑，对吧？

segments.en: No, but when you have a runny nose, there's lots of water coming out of your nose, right?
segments.zh: 不是，但你流鼻涕的时候，鼻子里会流出好多东西，对吧？

segments.en: Right. So it's interesting though, because when you run, you go fast, right?
segments.zh: 对。 所以这很有趣，因为当你跑步时，你走得很快，对吧？

segments.en: So a lot of water is coming fast out of your nose. Out of your nose.
segments.zh: 所以很多水从你的鼻子里流出来。 从你的鼻子里出来。

segments.en: Our fourth word today, slightly feverish.
segments.zh: 我们今天的第四个词，有点发烧。
有点发烧。 有点发烧。

segments.en: So again, slightly is a little bit.
segments.zh: 再说一次，slightly 就是一点点。
a little bit 加上 feverish。

segments.en: Well, let's break this word down.
segments.zh: 好吧，让我们分解这个词。

segments.en: We know fever, right? So when your body is very, very hot because you're sick.
segments.zh: 我们知道发烧，对吧？ 所以当你的身体非常非常热时，因为你生病了。

segments.en: So feverish is the feeling of your body being very, very hot.
segments.zh: 所以 feverish 就是感觉身体非常非常热。

segments.en: So you have a high temperature.
It's not that you have a high temperature, but you feel like you have a high temperature.
segments.zh: 并不是说你真的发烧，而是你觉得自己在发烧。

segments.en: And our last word, to recover.
segments.zh: 最后一个词是 to recover。

segments.en: So this means to get better, right?
segments.zh: 所以它的意思是好转，对吧？

segments.en: Can you only use it when you're sick?
segments.zh: 只有生病的时候才可以使用？

segments.en: So when you recover, you get better and you rest.
segments.zh: 所以 recover 就是好转、休息。

segments.en: So maybe you can say, I was so busy this week.
segments.zh: 所以也许你可以说，这周我很忙。

segments.en: I need to recover this weekend.
So yeah, if you feel tired or you feel sick, you can recover.
segments.zh: 所以，是的，如果你觉得累或者生病了，都能恢复过来。

segments.en: Let's listen to our dialogue again and we can listen to these words that we've just talked about.
segments.zh: 让我们再听一遍我们的对话，我们可以听听我们刚刚谈到的这些话。

segments.en: Actually, I'm feeling quite ill today.
segments.zh: 其实，我今天身体很不舒服。

segments.en: Oh, I'm sorry to hear that.
segments.zh: 哦，听到这个消息我很遗憾。

segments.en: I think I'm coming down with the flu.
I have a headache, a sore throat, a runny nose, and I'm feeling slightly feverish.
segments.zh: 我头痛，喉咙痛，流鼻涕，我感觉有点发烧。

segments.en: I was hoping to take the day off to recover.
segments.zh: 我想请一天假休息恢复。

segments.en: Okay, then try and get some rest.
In this dialogue, we listen to some really interesting phrases of how you can tell your boss that you are feeling sick, right?
segments.zh: 在这个对话中，我们听了一些非常有趣的短语，告诉你的老板你感觉不舒服，对吧？

segments.en: So let's look at these in Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 所以让我们看看这些在流利表达中。

segments.en: Okay, let's take a look at our first phrase on Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 好的，让我们来看看我们关于流利表达的第一个短语。

segments.en: All right. So let's listen to some examples and then we'll come back and explain this interesting phrase.
segments.zh: 好的。 所以让我们听一些例子，然后我们会回来解释这个有趣的短语。

segments.en: I think I'm coming down with a cold.
Example two. You have a runny nose.
segments.zh: 例句二。 你流鼻涕了。

segments.en: Are you coming down with the flu?
I think I'm coming down with something.
Okay, so basically coming down with means.
segments.zh: 好的，所以 coming down with 的意思就是……

segments.en: Okay, so you can use it with.
segments.zh: 好的，所以你可以使用它。

segments.en: I'm coming down with the flu.
I'm coming down with a cold.
I'm coming down with a cough.
Yeah, or I'm coming down with something.
segments.zh: 对，或者 I'm coming down with something。

segments.en: With something. You don't know what it is.
segments.zh: 就是 something。你不知道到底是什么病。

segments.en: Exactly. Okay, let's take a look at our second phrase.
segments.zh: 没错。 好的，让我们看看我们的第二个短语。

segments.en: So this phrase is great. You know, when you say I'm calling in sick, you're saying, hey, I'm not going to come to work today because I am sick.
segments.zh: 所以这句话很棒。 你知道，当你说我请病假时，你是在说，嘿，我今天不会来上班，因为我生病了。

segments.en: Okay, so literally it means that you call your office and you say you're not going to work.
segments.zh: 好吧，从字面上看，这意味着你打电话给你的办公室，你说你不去工作。

segments.en: Yes, but it's great because it's three words that show such a long idea.
segments.zh: 是的，但这很棒，因为它是三个词，显示出如此长的想法。

segments.en: Right, because otherwise you would have to say I'm calling because I don't feel well, so I'm not going to go to work.
segments.zh: 对，因为否则你不得不说我打电话是因为我感觉不舒服，所以我不会去上班。

segments.en: Yes, but if you say I'm calling in sick, everyone knows.
segments.zh: 是的，但如果你说我请病假，每个人都知道。

segments.en: That you're not going to go to work.
Yep. Okay, now let's take a look at our last phrase.
segments.zh: 是的。 好的，现在让我们看看我们的最后一句话。

segments.en: Now this is a great phrase.
segments.zh: 现在这是一个很好的短语。

segments.en: To take the day off is to?
segments.zh: to take the day off 是什么意思？

segments.en: Now you can say take the week off.
segments.zh: 现在你可以说请假一周。

segments.en: Take the month off or take the year off.
All right, so take the day off means to not go to work on that day.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以请假意味着那天不去上班。

segments.en: All right, let's listen to our dialogue again now and then we'll come back and talk a little bit more. Hello, Daniel speaking. How may I help you? Hi, Daniel.
segments.zh: 好吧，让我们现在再听一次对话，然后回来再聊一点。 你好，我是丹尼尔。 有什么可以帮您？ 嗨，丹尼尔。

segments.en: Actually, I'm feeling quite ill today.
segments.zh: 其实，我今天身体很不舒服。

segments.en: Oh, I'm sorry to hear that.
segments.zh: 哦，听到这个消息我很遗憾。

segments.en: I think I'm coming down with the flu.
I have a headache, a sore throat, a runny nose, and I'm feeling slightly feverish.
segments.zh: 我头痛，喉咙痛，流鼻涕，我感觉有点发烧。

segments.en: I see. So you're calling in sick.
segments.zh: 我明白。 所以你请病假。

segments.en: Yes, I was hoping to take the day off to recover.
segments.zh: 是的，我想请一天假好好恢复。

segments.en: Okay, then try and get some rest.
Well, Marco, have you ever done what Julie did?
segments.zh: 好吧，马可，你做过朱莉做过的事吗？

segments.en: Did you ever call your boss to say you're sick when you're not really?
segments.zh: 你有没有过根本没生病，却打电话跟老板请病假的经历？

segments.en: Yeah, of course. I mean, sometimes you just don't feel very well, but you're not really sick.
segments.zh: 是的，当然。 我的意思是，有时你只是感觉不太好，但你并没有真正生病。

segments.en: You just don't feel like going to work.
Or sometimes you have something to do, right? Yep. You know what we call those in Canada?
segments.zh: 或者有时你有事要做，对吧？ 是的。 你知道我们在加拿大叫什么吗？
我们管这叫 personal days（私人假期）。

segments.en: So you say, oh, I'm going to take a personal day, meaning I'm going to call in sick, but then go shopping.
segments.zh: 所以你说，哦，我要休个 personal day，意思就是打电话请病假，然后去逛街。

segments.en: We used to do that a lot because, for example, soccer games are such a big deal.
segments.zh: 我们过去经常这样做，因为例如，足球比赛是一件大事。

segments.en: Oh, yeah. And sometimes you would have a soccer match between, I don't know, Brazil, and it would be maybe at 10 a.m. or 11 a.m. So everyone would call in sick on that day.
segments.zh: 哦，是的。 有时你会在巴西之间进行一场足球比赛，可能是在上午 10 点或 11 点，所以那天每个人都会请病假。

segments.en: So the boss at least could plan that he would have an empty office.
segments.zh: 所以老板至少能预料到办公室会空着。

segments.en: Or sometimes you would take half the day off.
segments.zh: 或者有时你会休息半天。

segments.en: So you would just go, you say, well, I'm not going to make it in the morning, but I'll come in the afternoon.
segments.zh: 所以你就直接说，好吧，我早上赶不过来，但我下午会来。

segments.en: So you would recover very quickly.
I'm feeling a little bit sick, but I'm going to be better in the afternoon.
segments.zh: 我感觉有点不舒服，但下午就会好起来。

segments.en: So, well, if you have any questions or comments, please come to our website.
segments.zh: 所以，如果您有任何问题或意见，请访问我们的网站。

segments.en: And if you have any calling in sick stories, please let us know.
segments.zh: 如果你有请病假的趣事，请告诉我们。

segments.en: Yes. You can visit us at EnglishPod.com and Marco and I are always there to answer your questions.
segments.zh: 是的。 你可以访问 EnglishPod.com，Marco 和我随时都在那里解答你的问题。

segments.en: So we'll see you next time.
